Figure 2: Overview of the proposed multi-agent semantic rewriting framework for privacy-preserving RAG. The offline phase sanitizes raw documents through three collaborative agents (Pri-Extra agent, Sem-Extra agent, and Reconstruction agent), while the online phase retrieves over the original corpus but supplies only rewritten text to the LLM.
